metric: dependence of accuracy on decision rule vs model
quote: On imbalanced screening data, accuracy depends as much on the decision rule as on the model.

conditions.dataset: synthetic screening dataset of 1,200 rows with eight numeric features, 30% positives, 5% label noise, split 80/20 (data seed 7)
conditions.model: logistic regression trained by mini-batch SGD for 15 epochs (batch size 32, learning rate 0.05, constant schedule, no weight decay, no class weighting)
conditions.decision_threshold: positive rate of training data (base-rate threshold)
